why_a_gate_is_written_first: a serving probe produces a wall of vLLM log and it is trivially easy to read a PASS into it after the fact. This project has been burned by exactly that: probe C of the Nemotron series read a P100 scheduling failure as a model verdict and two more probes were spent on it.

STEP_0_HARDWARE.rule: if the probe prints GPU_GATE: FAIL, the run says NOTHING about the model. Re-push. Do not record it as evidence, do not count it against the model, and do not 'fix' the probe.
STEP_0_HARDWARE.why: all three earlier Nemotron probes were scheduled on a Tesla P100 despite correct metadata.

STEP_1_DOES_IT_SERVE.pass: the server answers /v1/models and returns a real completion
STEP_1_DOES_IT_SERVE.fail: vLLM exits. Record the exact error. An architecture error is now UNEXPECTED, because arc3-vllm-arch-probe-a confirmed both NemotronHForCausalLM and Qwen3NextForCausalLM are in our vLLM 0.19.0 registry.

STEP_2_THE_NUMBER_THAT_DECIDES_IT_IS_KV_.reference: Flash-Next serves with 81.8 GiB of weights via a host-offload patch and 5.0 GiB of KV.
STEP_2_THE_NUMBER_THAT_DECIDES_IT_IS_KV_.measured_prediction: both candidates are 74.8 GiB of weights on a 96 GiB card, which should leave about 13 GiB.
STEP_2_THE_NUMBER_THAT_DECIDES_IT_IS_KV_.PASS: KV cache >= 10 GiB, i.e. at least double Flash-Next. That is the entire reason to switch and it is what would let context and concurrency stop competing.
STEP_2_THE_NUMBER_THAT_DECIDES_IT_IS_KV_.MARGINAL: KV between 6 and 10 GiB. Serving works but the headroom argument is weak. Do NOT start a day of integration on this; bench it only if the wave's Flash-Next arms all tie again.
STEP_2_THE_NUMBER_THAT_DECIDES_IT_IS_KV_.REJECT: KV <= 5 GiB. The model fits but buys nothing, and a swap that buys nothing costs a day and re-opens every calibration this project has.

STEP_3_TOOL_CALLING_IS_A_HARD_REQUIREMEN.why: the architecture is ONE generic python tool. A model that serves and cannot emit the tool-call format our parsers expect is worth ZERO here, whatever its benchmarks say.
STEP_3_TOOL_CALLING_IS_A_HARD_REQUIREMEN.Qwen3CODER: expected to work with --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder unchanged, because it IS a Qwen3 coder model.
STEP_3_TOOL_CALLING_IS_A_HARD_REQUIREMEN.NEMOTRON: must have a compatible parser in vLLM 0.19.0. arc3-vllm-parser-probe-a lists what the wheelhouse carries. If no Nemotron-compatible tool parser exists, NEMOTRON IS REJECTED ON INTEGRATION regardless of how well it serves or reasons.
STEP_3_TOOL_CALLING_IS_A_HARD_REQUIREMEN.do_not: do not write a custom tool parser to rescue a model. That is a new load-bearing component in the winning path, on a deadline, with no evidence the model is better.

STEP_4_WHAT_A_PASS_BUYS_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES.a_pass_is_not_a_capability_result: it says the model can be served with more KV. It says NOTHING about levels. The capability question needs a 2.4 GPU-h 25-game bench against the Flash-Next family band of 40, 44, 47, 42.
STEP_4_WHAT_A_PASS_BUYS_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES.the_falsifier_for_the_whole_model_thesis: if a candidate serves, benches, and lands inside 40-47, then the model is NOT the ceiling. In that case this stack is finished near a 3.5 mean and the honest remaining plays are the free rotation hedge and the Paper Track. Write that down now so it is not explained away later.

order: QWEN3CODER first on integration risk, NEMOTRON second. Both run; the order is not a prediction about quality.
